text: The long Gym Challenge is nearing its end, I see.\c\nAre you ready to face Hammerlocke Gym and its\nleader, the dragon user Raihan?
You must remember that [VAR 1100(00FF,0100)]she who dares, wins.
In that case, please use the changing room to\nchange into your uniform.

That uniform you wear is a symbol of all of your
victories. I feel your determination.\c
Now, head to where all the Gym Trainers await...
No, not the stadium, but the vault!
Ah, one moment!\c\nYou need at least two battle-ready Pokémon\nto face Raihan!
The Gym mission, right?\nTogether with your partner, you can’t lose!
That uniform fits you to a tee!\nHead on in, number [VAR 01C4(0001)]!

Hold on there! If you want to face Raihan, you
first need to gather seven Gym Badges.\c
Only then will Raihan even think about letting
you face him!
